BoardUI - React Design System for Dashboards

name: BoardUI
summary: React and Tailwind design system for dashboards and agentic interfaces: 85 components and blocks, 19 chart cards, 10 Pro templates.
description: A copy-in design system built on Tailwind CSS v4: 78 documented components covering foundations (colour, typography, 400+ tokens), base components, chart cards, dashboard blocks and AI-agent pieces (composer, prompt input, agent thinking). Ten full-page Pro templates cover dashboard, project board, marketing, calendar, finance and AI chat. Installed with the boardui CLI or by AI agents through an MCP server.
contains: 85 React components and blocks, 19 of them chart cards
78 documented components: foundations, base components, blocks and charts
10 Pro templates incl. dashboard, project board, marketing, calendar, finance, medical, AI chat and AI image generation
installs via npx boardui init and npx boardui add; MCP server and agent skills for AI-driven installs
free source MIT on GitHub; Pro is a one-time purchase with lifetime updates
React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, React Aria, TanStack Table, Recharts; RTL support
shadcn-format registry with 63 items; 80 docs pages
